Definition: properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be marvellous, be wonderful, be surpassing, be extraordinary, separate by distinguishing action; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to be beyond one's power, be difficult to do; 1a2) to be difficult to understand; 1a3) to be wonderful, be extraordinary; 1a3a) marvellous (participle); 1b) (Piel) to separate (an offering); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to do extraordinary or hard or difficult thing; 1c2) to make wonderful, do wondrously; 1d) (Hithpael) to show oneself wonderful or marvellous
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
